title: Annotatio V §.VI: First grade — Tolerance alone = Consociatio partialis
pass_a_gloss: of which the one proceeds only as far as Tolerance, and is to be called partial Consociation;
pass_b_english: One degree reaches only as far as Tolerance.
That grade is rightly called partial Consociation.
source_text: quorum alter ad Tolerantiam duntaxat procedit, Consociatio partialis dicendus;
